an6.84:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāni yeva pāṭikaṃkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi
an6.84:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiccho hoti vighātavā asantuṭṭho itaritaracīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena asaddho hoti dussīlo hoti kusīto hoti muṭṭhassati hoti duppañño hoti
an6.84:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāni yeva pāṭikaṃkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuḍḍhi.
an6.84:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuḍḍhi yeva pāṭikaṃkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni
an6.84:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na mahiccho hoti na vighātavā santuṭṭho itaritaracīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena saddho hoti sīlavā hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti satimā hoti paññavā hoti
an6.84:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuḍḍhi yeva pāṭikaṃkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti.
